**Retiam Studio** (`studio/`) is an interactive, browser-native Integrated Development Environment (IDE) engineered specifically for authoring, fine-tuning, debugging, and exporting Retiam animations.
The Studio bridges rapid code iteration with immediate visual feedback:

items: **Embedded Monaco Code Editor**: Full TypeScript language server, syntax highlighting, autocompletion, and live error diagnostics.

**AST-Aware Parameter Inspector**: Automatic cursor-driven parameter detection (colors, rate curves, spring physics, geometry dimensions, transforms) enabling instant visual tuning directly in the editor.
**Live WebGPU Scene Host**: Low-latency hot reloading of animations on code changes with state preservation.
**Production Export Panel**: In-browser interface for rendering 4K MP4/WebM videos, WebP animations, and high-resolution snapshots without opening terminal CLI tools.

blocks.text: A. Monaco Editor & Bi-Directional Code Sync ([studio/editor/](../studio/editor/))

items: **TypeScript Transpilation**: The editor compiles ESNext/TypeScript scene code in real time using the Monaco TypeScript worker and WebAssembly SWC/esbuild.

**Bi-Directional AST Updates**: When a slider or curve handle in the Inspector HUD is adjusted, the editor locates the exact AST source range and updates the text in-place without triggering full reloads.

blocks.content: For the complete widget catalogue and trigger specifications, see [`STUDIO_INSPECTOR.md`](/notes-studio-inspector).

blocks.text: As the cursor navigates across scene code, the Inspector scans tokens:

items: Easing functions (`Rate.bezier`, `Rate.easeOutCubic`) $\to$ Interactive cubic-bezier curve editor.
Color definitions (`Color.fromHex`, gradients) $\to$ Color picker and palette chips.
Spring parameters (`Rate.spring`) $\to$ Live dynamic settling graph with mass/damping sliders.
Geometric parameters (`Poly`, `Rect`, `Circle`) $\to$ Radius, corner smoothing, and sides sliders.

blocks.text: The preview canvas executes the compiled scene inside an isolated sandbox:

items: **Hot Scene Swap**: Clears the previous scene graph, invalidates GPU pipeline caches, and mounts the new scene while preserving current camera angles and playback timestamps.

children: Active entity count and draw call count.
Estimated VRAM consumption across state, geometry, and texture allocators.

blocks.text: Provides a visual interface to Retiam's export engine:

items: **Frame Rate**: 30 FPS, 60 FPS, or custom cinematic rates (24, 120 FPS).
**Format Options**: MP4 (H.264/AAC), WebM (VP9/Opus), animated GIF, or ZIP archives containing raw PNG image sequences.
**Select Demo / Template**: Choose from 40+ pre-built mathematical and cinematic demos in the sidebar.
**Live Authoring**: Modify entities, easing curves, and camera choreography. The preview canvas hot-reloads instantly.
**Visual Parameter Tweaking**: Click any color or number in the editor to fine-tune values via the floating HUD.
**One-Click Export**: Click **Render Video**, select resolution and format, and download the finished production video.
